name: H-Beam
description: Creates an H-beam profile by combining three boxes (web and two flanges) and extrudes it.
code:
def make_h_beam(self):
    base_wp = cq.Workplane('XY').center(self.h_offset_x, 0)
    web = base_wp.box(self.h_web_thickness, self.h_height - 2 * self.h_flange_thickness, self.length)
    top_flange = base_wp.center(0, (self.h_height - self.h_flange_thickness) / 2).box(self.h_width, self.h_flange_thickness, self.length)
    bottom_flange = base_wp.center(0, -(self.h_height - self.h_flange_thickness) / 2).box(self.h_width, self.h_flange_thickness, self.length)
    self.h_beam = web.union(top_flange).union(bottom_flange)
    self.model = self.h_beam

name: L-Beam
description: Creates an L-beam profile and places it in the center, replacing the previous I-beam.
code:
def make_l_beam(self):
    base_wp = cq.Workplane('XY').center(self.l_offset_x, 0)
    vert_leg = base_wp.center(-self.l_width / 2 + self.l_thickness / 2, 0).box(self.l_thickness, self.l_height, self.length)
    horiz_leg = base_wp.center(0, -self.l_height / 2 + self.l_thickness / 2).box(self.l_width, self.l_thickness, self.length)
    self.l_beam = vert_leg.union(horiz_leg)
    self.model = self.model.union(self.l_beam)

name: T-Bar
description: Creates a T-bar profile with a single top flange and a web, placing it on the right side.
code:
def make_t_bar(self):
    base_wp = cq.Workplane('XY').center(self.t_offset_x, 0)
    web = base_wp.center(0, -self.t_flange_thickness / 2).box(self.t_web_thickness, self.t_height - self.t_flange_thickness, self.length)
    top_flange = base_wp.center(0, (self.t_height - self.t_flange_thickness) / 2).box(self.t_width, self.t_flange_thickness, self.length)
    self.t_bar = web.union(top_flange)
    self.model = self.model.union(self.t_bar)

name: Fillet Inner Edges
description: Fillets the specified inner corner edges of the H-beam, L-beam, and T-beam sequentially to avoid selector union errors.
code:
def fillet_inner_edges(self):
    x1 = self.h_offset_x + self.h_web_thickness / 2
    y1 = self.h_height / 2 - self.h_flange_thickness
    x2 = self.l_offset_x - self.l_width / 2 + self.l_thickness
    y2 = -self.l_height / 2 + self.l_thickness
    x3 = self.t_offset_x - self.t_web_thickness / 2
    y3 = self.t_height / 2 - self.t_flange_thickness
    self.model = self.model.edges(cq.NearestToPointSelector((x1, y1, 0))).fillet(self.fillet_radius)
    self.model = self.model.edges(cq.NearestToPointSelector((x2, y2, 0))).fillet(self.fillet_radius)
    self.model = self.model.edges(cq.NearestToPointSelector((x3, y3, 0))).fillet(self.fillet_radius)
